answers: review_lenses finding lens-performance-code finding 1: wrong — two `locked_state_update` calls per iteration is a deliberate correctness tradeoff required by DSITER-1: the iter-start write records the iteration counter before dispatch so a mid-iteration SIGINT can be recovered; without it resume would restart from iter 1. The performance cost (one extra flock+jq per iteration) is the price of resumability on the cycle hot path. This is not a defect.
